sentence: This project studies how the inability to withstand difficult experiences changes from moment to moment and relates to cigarette smoking in daily life.
This project studies how a lipid-raft scaffold protein helps the human immunodeficiency virus and a coronavirus assemble virus particles.
This project uses positron emission tomography imaging to track T-cell activation in tumors during herpes simplex virus immunotherapy for glioblastoma.
This project builds shared laboratory and data analysis services that support biomedical research on cancer and health disparities.
This project builds a system that uses motion sensors to choose settings for deep brain stimulation that ease symptoms of movement disorders.
This project uses CRISPR to test regulatory elements in regions linked to schizophrenia and find the genes they control.
This project studies how fentanyl changes the single cell transcriptome of blood cells from people with HIV.
This project studies how type I interferon helps breast cancer cells resist therapy and looks for a protein that could be a treatment target.
This project measures environmental toxicants and studies molecular mechanisms in a diabetes prevention study to see how the toxicants relate to disease risk.
This project builds electrode tools that record the electrical activity of muscles in different species and body parts.
This project studies how the plexin-semaphorin pathway in sensory nerve cells is controlled and how it contributes to persistent pain after nerve injury.
This project studies how auditory experiences affect adaptive myelination and neural plasticity in the auditory brainstem circuit.
This project studies how genetic changes in colorectal cancer tumors relate to the benefit of aspirin treatment, using genomic and immune profiling.
This project builds genetic tests that tell which children with leukemia are more or less likely to be cured with standard therapy.
This project builds an endometrial organoid from human pluripotent stem cells to find how the endometrial stem cell niche forms.
This project runs a skin research center that provides shared technology and data for studies of skin diseases.
This project sets up a computational server to speed up machine learning that finds model equations for biomedical processes.
This project builds two toxin proteins that target receptors and penetrate tumor stroma, and tests them in mice with human pancreatic cancer.
This project studies how RNAs that contain a cyclic phosphate are made and what they do, including how they affect mRNA stability and immune responses.
This project tests a small molecule that blocks noggin so lower levels of bone morphogenetic proteins can cause bone formation for spinal fusion.
